نستقوي (form X)
# نَسْتَقْوِي (nastaqwī) /nas.taq.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْوَى (istaqwā)
# نَسْتَقْوِيَ (nastaqwiya) /nas.taq.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَقْوَى (istaqwā)
